title: The Pale Merchant
text: A lantern gutters in an alcove. A hooded figure spreads a cloth: one relic, gleaming. "Coin," it rasps, "or something warmer."

run.__fn: (G, r, s) => { G.gold -= 60; return { text: "It hands you " + evRelic(G, r, s) + " and melts into the dark.", good: true }; }
(G, r, s) => { G.php -= 20; return { text: "The knife stings. " + evRelic(G, r, s) + " is yours.", good: true }; }
() => ({ text: "You keep walking. The lantern fades behind you.", good: true })

title: A Voice in the Dark
text: Someone is trapped under fallen beams. "Help me," they wheeze, "and I will not forget it." Digging them out will cost you supplies.

run.__fn: G => { G.gold -= 10; G.pending = { floor: G.floor + 1, gold: 30, src: "A debt repaid" }; return { text: "They limp off into the dark, whispering a promise.", good: true }; }
() => ({ text: "Their curses follow you down the stair.", good: false })

title: Scratching in the Walls
text: Behind the brickwork: skrit, skrit, skrit. Something is in there. Something, or someone's stash.

run.__fn: (G, r) => r() < 0.5 ? (G.gold += 25, { text: "A hidden cache! +25 gold.", good: true }) : (G.php -= 6, { text: "Teeth. Many teeth. -6 HP.", good: false })
() => ({ text: "Some walls are better left whole.", good: true })

title: The Chained Ghost
text: A translucent figure bars the path, dragging a locket on a chain. "Carry it for me," it moans, "and my shield is yours. It is... heavy."

run.__fn: G => { G.defB += 5; G.spdB -= 5; return { text: "Cold iron settles around you. +5 DEF, -5 SPD.", good: true }; }
() => ({ text: "The ghost sighs and drifts through the wall.", good: true })

title: Knife at Your Throat
text: A thief drops from the ceiling, blade already out. "The purse. Or we see what you're made of."

run.__fn: G => { G.gold -= 15; return { text: "The thief bows mockingly and vanishes.", good: false }; }

(G, r) => luckRoll(G, r, 0.6) ? (G.gold += 20, { text: "You win — and take their purse. +20 gold.", good: true }) : (G.php -= 8, G.gold = Math.max(0, G.gold - 10), { text: "The blade finds you. -8 HP, -10 gold.", good: false })

title: The Glimmering Pool
text: Water pools in a basin of pale stone, lit from below by nothing at all. It smells like rain from the world above.

run.__fn: G => { G.php += 8; return { text: "Warmth spreads through you. +8 HP.", good: true }; }
() => ({ text: "You cup a handful, then let it fall.", good: true })

title: Rusted Spike Trap
text: The floor ahead is a carpet of rusted spikes, older than the dungeon's name. There is no way around.

run.__fn: G => { G.spdB -= 5; return { text: "You make it — but your boots are ruined. -5 SPD.", good: false }; }
G => { G.php -= 6; return { text: "Almost. A spike rakes your leg. -6 HP.", good: false }; }

title: The Imp's Dice
text: An imp sits cross-legged on a barrel, rattling bone dice. "Double or nothing, delver. The dice never lie. I do, but the dice never."

run.__fn: (G, r) => luckRoll(G, r, 0.5) ? (G.gold += 30, { text: "The dice smile on you. +30 gold.", good: true }) : (G.gold -= 15, { text: "The imp cackles and pockets your coin. -15 gold.", good: false })
() => ({ text: "The imp shrugs. \"Wise. Boring, but wise.\"", good: true })

title: Altar of the Deep
text: A black altar, worn smooth by ten thousand palms. The groove down its center is stained a color you decide not to name.

run.__fn: G => { G.php -= 5; G.atkB += 2; return { text: "The altar drinks. Your arms feel like iron. +2 ATK.", good: true }; }
G => { G.php += 3; return { text: "A small mercy settles over you. +3 HP.", good: true }; }

title: The Glowing Mushroom
text: A fist-sized mushroom pulses faint blue in the dark. Every delver knows the stories. Half of them end well.

run.__fn: (G, r) => luckRoll(G, r, 0.5) ? (G.pmax += 4, G.php += 4, { text: "Power blooms in your chest. +4 MAX HP.", good: true }) : (G.php -= 4, { text: "Your stomach disagrees. Violently. -4 HP.", good: false })
() => ({ text: "It pulses on, patient, for the next fool.", good: true })

title: The Dead Miner's Map
text: A skeleton in a miner's helm clutches a folded chart. Its jaw hangs open, as if mid-bargain. A living voice from nowhere: "Ten gold, and the good veins are yours."

run.__fn: G => { G.gold -= 10; G.pending = { floor: G.floor + 1, gold: 25, src: "The miner's veins" }; return { text: "Marked in a dead man's hand: where the gold hides below.", good: true }; }

(G, r) => luckRoll(G, r, 0.5) ? (G.pending = { floor: G.floor + 1, gold: 25, src: "The miner's veins" }, { text: "You pry the map from cold fingers. The dark stays silent... this time.", good: true }) : (G.php -= 6, G.spdB -= 3, { text: "The miner's grip tightens. A dead-man's curse: -6 HP, -3 SPD.", good: false })
() => ({ text: "You leave the miner his map. Some bargains outlive the bargainer.", good: true })

title: A Chest, Unclaimed
text: A banded chest sits in the open, unlocked, unguarded, in a dungeon that has never once been kind. It is exactly as suspicious as it looks.

run.__fn: (G, r) => r() < 0.4 ? (G.gold += 40, { text: "Actual treasure. Unbelievable. +40 gold.", good: true }) : (G.defB -= 1, G.php -= 4, { text: "A curse of rot seeps out. -1 DEF, -4 HP.", good: false })
() => ({ text: "You've read this story before. You walk on.", good: true })
